free_parameters.name: q_len
free_parameters.why: the target guard needs q_len != 1; the dilated2 branch only slices this length

free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: the target decision does not inspect the batch dimension

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: the target decision does not inspect the head count

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: the target decision does not inspect the head dimension

free_parameters.name: head_id
free_parameters.why: the target guard is evaluated before the pattern lookup uses head_id

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU tensors are only used to reach the target guard

free_parameters.name: streaming
free_parameters.why: the negative case must leave the dilated branches and reach a defined post-target call; streaming is the branch with a deterministic post-target stand-in

free_parameters.name: streaming_n_init
free_parameters.why: streaming_kwargs is read only after the target guard, so the value is irrelevant to the decision

free_parameters.name: streaming_n_local
free_parameters.why: streaming_kwargs is read only after the target guard, so the value is irrelevant to the decision

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed and single-threaded CPU keep repeated traces identical

free_parameters.name: device
free_parameters.why: the harness runs on CPU only; the CUDA allocation at import is remapped during import
